03/10.07.2025:

This anticipatory bail application under Section(s) 482 and 484 of the Bharatiya
Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (Bnss), 2023, has been preferred by the petitioner apprehending his
arrest for the offences registered under Section(s) 498A, 323, 341 Ipc read with Sections 3, 4 of the
Dowry Prohibition Act in connection with Balumath P.S. Case No. 25/2024, pending in the Court of
learned Cjm, Latehar.
Heard the parties at length and had gone through the documents, annexed along with this application.
Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.
The petitioner is the husband and there is allegation that the petitioner has tortured the wife and has also demanded dowry.

During course of argument, learned counsel for the State submits that it has come in the case diary that the petitioner in compliance of notice under Section 41A Cr.P.C, had appeared before the police and has got his statement recorded.
She submits that the petitioner is cooperating with the investigation.
